selection_policy.primary_focus_rule: select the last source-backed unresolved hot open question already projected into context-pack.json
selection_policy.background_rule: carry the latest open obligation and latest cooling retrospective as compact continuity checks

primary_focus.text: can clean preanswer-clamped external response evidence determine whether compact reentry confirms, narrows, or reverses?

latest_obligation.title: obtain clean preanswer-clamped external replay response, custody record, and separate score sheet
latest_obligation.discharge: clean response/custody/score-sheet triplet exists and has been scored, or compact gate is explicitly reversed/narrowed because the triplet fails

latest_retrospective.title: recheck whether preanswer material clamp reduces clean-response risk or becomes another gate-only loop
latest_retrospective.discharge: decide after OQ-0266 whether the preanswer bundles/scorer/custody templates should stay, shrink, or be replaced.
